aboutH2: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health: Residential Rehab in Cookstown, Ontario
intro: Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health rehab provides kind, compassionate, evidence-based services for men and women struggling with substance use as well as co-occurring mental health conditions such as mood disorders, borderline personality disorder, PTSD, and more. Simcoe Rehab offers a full continuum of care including medical detox, residential treatment, a family program, specialty programs for first responders and veterans, and alumni aftercare services. Their holistic approach provides individualized treatment plan options. An abundance of programming along with self care options makes this facility truly unique.

A typical week at Simcoe includes 4 individual therapy sessions weekly and 25 group therapy sessions that include skills groups, process groups, and trauma-based groups. Throughout the week, clients will have the opportunity to engage in family integration therapy sessions, a weekly family support group, support groups, eye movement therapy (EMDR), recovery care, aqua therapy, nutritional education, yoga, and physical fitness.

pillars.title: A Red Brick House on a Country Property Near Cookstown
pillars.body: The program runs out of a red brick house on a large rural property on 3 Line, just outside Cookstown in Simcoe County. Inside there's a living room, a dining area, a recreation room and a gym, and a separate wing holds the indoor pool, sauna and lounge. Outside you'll find a pond at the front of the property, a small waterfall where people sit with a book or a coffee, a tennis court, basketball nets and a fire pit. Rooms are shared by default because the team wants people to have company, though private rooms can be booked for an extra fee. Recovery.com lists the centre at 16 to 30 beds.

pillars.title: Aftercare That Stays Free for Life
pillars.body: Planning for discharge starts in the first week. Before you go home you write a relapse prevention plan with your primary counsellor, and a psychiatrist does a final assessment in your last week. For the first three months after treatment there's a one-to-one check-in once a month. A virtual aftercare group meets every Wednesday at 7 p.m., and graduates can keep coming for as long as they like at no cost. Families have their own virtual support group on Thursdays at 7 p.m. If you don't have a family doctor, the centre says it will help you find one.

pillars.title: Psychotherapists, Counsellors and a Medical Team on Site
pillars.body: Each client is paired with a psychotherapist for four private sessions a week, and certified addiction and mental health counsellors run the 25 groups that fill the rest of the week. Addictions physician Dr. Ron Phillipson leads the medical team, which also includes psychiatrist Dr. Lori Weisberg, clinical psychologist Dr. Christine Courbasson and several registered practical nurses. Raymond Moore is the clinical director. Two Red Seal chefs cook the meals, and the centre says some of its staff have been through recovery themselves.

overviewH2: Simcoe Addiction And Mental Health: Center Overview
overview: SAMH believes that healing from trauma and emotional pain requires more than just therapy. They provide four therapy sessions per week and four groups per day, as well as time for reflection, fun, and relaxation. They believe that having fun is important in recovery and finding new activities can help the brain experience pleasure in a healthier way.

SAMH welcomes all approaches to recovery and understands that there is no one-size-fits-all solution. They use evidence-based therapeutic techniques like Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy to work with clients, and have experienced therapists, certified addiction counsellors, and nurses who provide medical support and assistance throughout the process.

afterOverview: After finishing the Simcoe program, clients walk away with a wide array of valuable skills learned such as a sense of freedom, increased self esteem, forgiveness, increased energy levels, confidence, better physical health, and a brighter outlook on life. Simcoe doesn’t stop there, they go one step further by offering a life-time of aftercare services. Aftercare consists of weekly aftercare meetings that allow individuals the opportunity to connect on a regular basis.

Simcoe Addiction and Mental Health is located in Cookstown, Canada. The facility has plenty of amenities for clients to enjoy. A beautiful pond is located at the front of the property, and there is plenty of space for walking or jogging around the facility. Clients can also enjoy a tennis court, a gym, a sauna, an indoor pool, a hot tub, and a fire pit. Simcoe’s well-rounded program combined with a luxurious setting makes this center a top-notch choice.

location.heading: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health in Cookstown, Ontario
location.intro: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health sits on a country property at 4136 3 Line, just outside the village of Cookstown in the Town of Innisfil, a few minutes from where Highway 400 meets Highway 89. Toronto is about an hour south by car and Barrie is around 20 minutes north, while Bradford, Alliston and Newmarket are each roughly 15 to 30 minutes away.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com lists an estimated cash-pay rate of $29,500 CAD for 30 days at Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health. The centre's own website doesn't publish prices, and the total depends on how long you stay. A private room costs extra. The centre does not charge HST on its treatment services.

faqs.q: How long is the residential program?
faqs.a: The residential program runs for at least 30 days, with 45, 60 and 90-day options. The clinical team assesses each person and recommends a length, and the centre says it can arrange a longer plan when someone needs more time.

faqs.q: Does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health offer detox?
faqs.a: Yes, withdrawal management happens on site in Cookstown. Nurses monitor every client closely for the first 72 hours, and a medical doctor can prescribe withdrawal medication when it's needed. If you take methadone or Suboxone, or want to start opioid agonist treatment, tell the team before you arrive so they can plan for it.

faqs.q: What services does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health provide?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health provides addiction and mental health services to individuals struggling with substance abuse and co-occurring mental health disorders.

faqs.q: Where is Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health located?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health is located in Cookstown, Ontario.

faqs.q: How far is it from Toronto, and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The campus is about an hour's drive north of Toronto, at 4136 3 Line in Cookstown, near Highway 400 in the Town of Innisfil. Barrie is around 20 minutes away. Tours are by appointment only, so call 1-833-304-8181 before you visit.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it's a private centre, so OHIP doesn't cover the program fees. The centre gives you a detailed receipt to send to insurers that cover treatment outside provincial funding, and its recovery.com profile names GreenShield, Sun Life, Manulife, Desjardins and RBC. Coverage varies by plan, so check your own policy first.

faqs.q: What is the aftercare program that Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health offers?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health offers an aftercare program that includes continuing care groups and a free alumni support group to ensure that clients have access to the resources they need to maintain their sobriety.

faqs.q: What kind of approach to treatment does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health use?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health uses a holistic, evidence-based approach to treatment that prioritizes healing the mind and body concurrently.

faqs.q: Who is included in the staff at Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health?
faqs.a: The staff at Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health includes psychiatrists, addiction doctors, registered psychotherapists, and certified addiction counselors.

faqs.q: How does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health develop personalized treatment plans?
faqs.a: Upon arrival, the staff at Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health will work closely with the client to develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to their specific needs.

faqs.q: How does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health support clients throughout the recovery process?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health has a compassionate team of professionals, including nurses, medical doctors, psychiatrists, certified addiction counselors, and master’s level psychotherapists, who are there to support clients throughout the recovery process.

faqs.q: How does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health help clients cope with their emotions and feelings?
faqs.a: Certified addiction counselors offer support and guidance to help clients cope with their emotions and feelings throughout the recovery process.

faqs.q: How does Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health ensure continuous care management?
faqs.a: Simcoe Addiction & Mental Health ensures continuous care management through its aftercare program, which includes continuing care groups and a free alumni support group.
